### Your Life Is Like the Morning Fog - (James 4:14) - Your Daily Bible Verse - December 14
Author: Jennifer Heeren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/life-is-short-bible-study-minute-december-14-2018.html
Passage: James 4:14
Points:
- Earthly life is temporary, so our days should be lived for God's glory rather than self-centered pursuits.
- Serving and loving others with kindness brings deep fulfillment and points people toward God.
- Because no one knows the span of their life, we should focus on the breadth and purpose of each day.
- Keeping the brevity of life in mind cures procrastination and spurs us to persevere in doing good.

### Prioritizing What Matters Most - Encouragement for Today - November 18, 2022
Author: Kia Stephens
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-november-18-2022.html
Passage: James 4:14
Points:
- People often boast about tomorrow by assuming they have unlimited time to invest in loved ones later.
- Getting consumed by urgent daily tasks can cause us to miss fleeting moments that matter most.
- James compares our earthly existence to a vanishing vapor to remind us that tomorrow is never guaranteed.
- Walking in God's will requires prioritizing meaningful connection with people over productivity and work.
